reason: A DSH Web plugin that monitors OpenCode Go quota through the official usage API, visualizes multi-window usage in the input area, and provides threshold-based interface and agent prompt reminders.

summaries.zh: 通过官方用量接口监控 OpenCode Go 的五小时、每周和每月额度，并在 DSH Web 中显示可切换的进度圆环与阈值提醒。
summaries.en: Monitors OpenCode Go usage through its official usage API and shows switchable five-hour, weekly, and monthly quota rings with threshold reminders in DSH Web.

capabilities: Reads an OpenCode Go API key from a local auth file or environment variable
Calls the OpenCode Go usage API with bearer authentication
Displays quota usage and reset information in the web interface
Injects quota status reminders into agent system prompts
Runs a host-side Node subprocess to read local authentication data
